No. 7439 Title: खड्गमालाभाष्य Author: भास्कराचार्य Script: देवनागरी Extent: 28
Govt. Mss. Lib., Bhandarkar O. R. Institute, Pune (India)
।। śrīśaṃ vaṃde ।। ṛbhukṣirudrapadmajācyutādayopi ye mṛtervaśaṃ na dānatastrayaḥ suvāsinīpadaspṛśaḥ ।।
maheśvarasya mṛtyudāsmarasya sākṣiṇī tu yā। sumaṃgalīriyaṃ vadhūrimāṃ sameta paśyata ।। 1 ।।
śrīrāmadevadeśikacaraṇābje manasi rahasya dadhanā ।। bhāratyupākhyo bhārakararatyo gaṃbhīrarāyasunaḥ ।। 2 ।।
vidyāpaṃcadaśārṇodbhavamālāmaṃtrapaṃcadaśakasya ।। uddhāraṃ vyākurute lalitāpariśiṣṭataṃtramadhyagataṃ ।। 3 ।।
śrīdevyuvāca ।।
bhagavandevadeveśa sarvajña karuṇānidhe ।। mālāmaṃtrānsamācakṣva kādividyāsamudbhavān ।। 1 ।।
śrīśiva uvāca ।।
mālāmaṃtrānpravakṣyāmi mahārājñīmahodayān ।। yeṣāṃ smaraṇamātreṇa karasthāḥ sarvasiddhayaḥ ।। 2 ।।
ekāśītiyutairekaśatanāmabhiraṃkitaḥ ।। mālāmaṃtro namaḥ śabdapuṭastripurasuṃdarī ।। 3 ।।
tithisaṃkhyasuvarṇaratnamālojvalagarbhāṃ śivanirmitāmanarghyāṃ ।। lalitāpariśiṣṭaṃ ratnapeṭīmalamutkīlayituṃ guroḥ kuleyaṃ ।। 4 ।।
(1a) tatrādau devīpraśnaḥ śivaṃ prati ।। yadyapi strīdevatyaḥ smṛtā vidyāmaṃtrāḥ puṃdevatāsmṛtā iti paribhāṣayā tripurasuṃdarī- devatyānāṃ vidyā tvameva yuktaṃ। tathāpi maṃtraśabdasya manuviśeṣa iva manusāmānyepi śakteścatuḥśatādhikasaṃkhyākārṇamanūnāṃ mālāmaṃtra ityeva saṃjñāyāḥ satvācca tathoktiḥ ।।
prastārasahasrākṣaryupasthānasahasrākṣaryādivyāvartanāyakāditi ।। kāmarājavidyākṣaraiḥ paṃcadaśabhirutpannānpaṃcadaśasaṃkhyākān vadetyarthaḥ ।। 1 ।।
mahārājñī lalitā mahānudayo jñānasūryasyayaistān siddhayaḥ। aihikāmuṣmikaphalāni bhogamokṣamadā iti tu phalitārthaḥ ।। 2 ।।
nāmābhirviśeṣeṇa viśeṣya sādhāraṇaiḥ prātipadikaiḥ puṭaḥ nāmasamūhasyādāvaṃte ca nama iiti śabdadvayaṃ ।। tāni nāmāni gaṇaitumārabhate ।। tripurasuṃdarītyādinā ।। 3 ।।
ṣaḍaṃgāni hṛdayādyastrāṃtāni tadabhimānidevatāḥ ṣaṭnityāḥ kāmeśvaryādicitrāṃtāḥ paṃcadaśamahānityā caiketi ṣoḍaśa ।। (1b) deśikāḥ guravaḥ divyaughasiddhaughamānavaughabhedena kramātsatyacaturaṣṭasaṃkhyā ityekonnaviṃśatiḥ aṇimādisiddhayo daśa ।। brahmādyā mātaroṣṭau ।। saṃhṛtya tripurasuṃdaryā saha ṣaṣṭirnāmāni ।। 4 ।। sarvasaṃkṣobhaṇamudrādidevyo daśa ।। kāmākarṣaṇyādyā ākarṣaṇīpadaghaṭitāḥ ṣoḍaśaḥ ।। anaṃgapadaghaṭitā anaṃga ।। tataḥ
ṣaḍaṃgadevyaḥ ṣaṭnityāḥ ṣoḍaśadeśikāḥ ।। munivedanāgasaṃkhyā daśāṣṭau siddhimātaraḥ ।। 4 ।।
mudrākarṣaṃṇyanaṃgākhyā daśaṣoḍaśakuṃjarāḥ ।। kramādiṃdrādaśadiśaḥ sarvaśabdādyadevatāḥ ।। 5 ।।
vākdevatā heti yuktamahatyoṣṭāṣṭadevatāḥ ।। mahābhaṭṭārike paścānmahābhaṭṭārikaikalā ।। 6 ।।
kusumādayaḥ kuṃjarasaṃkhyākā aṣṭāvityarthaḥ ।। kramāditi dehalī dīpanyāyenobhayatrānveti ।। iṃdrāścaturdaśa ।। sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇyādyāḥ ।। sarvasiddhimadādyā daśa ।। sarvajñādyā api diksaṃkhyākā daśaiva ।। ete trayo gaṇāḥ sarvaśabdapadaghaṭitāḥ mudrādigaṇaiḥ saha ṣaḍapi devatāgaṇaḥ bhinnabhinnacakrasthāḥ tattaccakrāṃte dve dve nāmanīti (2a) uttaratra vakṣyate ।। tena aśītiḥ ।। saṃhatya catvāriṃśaduttaraśatanāmāni ।। 5 ।। vaśinyādyā vāgdevyaḥ aṣṭau saptamaṃ cakraṃ ।। hetibhirāyudhadevatābhirmīlitāḥ mahatyo mahāśabdavatyaḥ ।। aṣṭau samaṃ syāditi nyāyena catasraścatasraḥ vibhajya kathanāt (dvitīya) catuṣkamevāṣṭamaṃ cakraṃ ।। mahābhaṭṭāriketi devyāḥ saṃbuddhiḥ mahābhaṭṭāriketi dvitīyaṃ dvitīyavāramuktameva maṃtraghaṭakaṃ ।। ekalā ekaiva devatā ।। navamaṃ cakraṃ ।। cakradvayāṃte dve dve nāmānīti militvā trayoviṃśatiḥ ।। saṃhatya triṣaṣṭyuttaraśataṃ ।। 6 ।। tattadaṃte ।। ukteṣu navacakradevatāgaṇeṣu ekaikagaṇāṃte ।। trailokyamohanādicakranāma navakasyaikaikapaṭaghaṭitamaikaikaṃ nāma ।। taduttaraṃ makaṭādiyoginīnāma navakasthamekamiti dve dve nāma niyojye ।। saṃkhyā tu militaiva ।। athetyasya mahābhaṭṭārikottarapaṭhitaṃ cakrayoginīnāma dvayānaṃtaramityarthaḥ ।। 7 ।। tripurādīni cakreśvarīṇāṃ navanāmāni ।। tataḥ parāṇyapi navaiva nāmāni ।। (2b) mahāmahāśabdaghaṭitāni navamacakreśvaryāviśeṣaṇāni ।। tataḥ parāṇyapi saṃhatyaikāśītyuttaraśatanāmāni darśitāni ।। asya samūhasyādāvaṃte ca namaḥ śabdo deya ityuktameva ।। tataścaramanamaḥ śabdottaraṃ te trirityakṣaradvayaṃ svarūpaṃ ।। śucipriyāvahnijāyeti svāhā śabdaścetyarthaḥ ।। 8 ।।
cakrāṇāṃ yogināṃ ca tattadaṃte navābhidhāḥ ।। atha cakreśvarīṇāmapyākhyā nava tato nava ।। 7 ।।
mahāmahāṃti nāmāni tataste triḥśucipriyā ।। eṣa brahmadarīṃdrādidevānāmapi durlabhaḥ ।। 8 ।।
saṃpradāyakramaprāpya evaṃ sarvaphalapradaḥ ।। mālāmaṃtro mahādevi tārādyaḥ tārakaistribhiḥ ।। 9 ।।
tārādyaḥ prāthamikanamaḥ padātpūrvaṃ tāraḥ oṃkāro deyaḥ ।। eṣaḥ praṇavādisvāhāṃtaḥ saṃdarbhastāratrayapuṭitaḥ kāryaḥ ।। 9 ।।
tadevāha ramayeti ।। prathamaṃ ramābījapuṭitaḥ adāvaṃte ca śrībījasahitaḥ tadviśiṣṭaḥ saṃdarbhaḥ punarmāyābījena (3a) hrīṃkāreṇa saṃpuṭitaḥ tadubhayaviśiṣṭaḥ saṃdarbhaḥ puranarādyaṃtayaurvācā aiṃkāreṇa sahitaḥ kāryaḥ vāṅmāyākamalānāṃ tritārīsaṃjñā kalpasūtre prasiddhā ।। namaḥ padadvayaṃte triḥsvāheti padatrayaṃ satyabījānyapi padānevetyabhiprāyeṇa trinavatyādhikyamuktaṃ ।। ekāśītyadhikaśata ।।
ramayā māyayā vācā puṭitaḥ puṭitaḥ punaḥ ।। itthaṃ padāni mālāyāṃ trinavatyadhikaṃ śataṃ ।। 10 ।।
prātipadikamātroddhārepi vakṣyamāṇa vibhaktyabhiprāyeṇa padānītyuktaṃ ।। 10 ।।
śaktidevatyaśivadevatyobhayadevatyabhedādeva maṃtrastrividhaḥ uktāni prātipadikāni śaktidevatyapakṣe yathā lakṣaṇaṃ ṅīpuṭāvaṃtāni ।। śivadevatyapakṣe yathā sthitāni dvaṃdvadevatya pakṣe pratyekaṃ padadvayaṃ samuccayarūpāṇi paṭhanīyānītyarthaḥ ।। stripuṃmithuneti padyātmakasamāsatvānna strīpuṃseti samāsāṃtapratyayaprasaṃgaḥ ।। mālāmaṃtrasya viśeṣatvābhiprāyeṇa tā iti strīliṃganirdeśaḥ ।। te mālāmaṃtrāḥ pratyekaṃ paṃcadhā ।।
(3b) śuddhā upapadarahitāstrayaḥ namoṃtimānama iti padena pratināmāṃte yuktāstrayaḥ svāhāṃtimāḥ pratiprātipadikaṃ svāheti pallavaṃtatrayaḥ tṛptistarpayāmīti padaṃ na tu tṛpyatviti ।। tadaṃtimānāmānastrayaḥ jayau jayajayeti padadvayaṃ aṃtimau prati
mālāmaṃtrastridhā devi strīpuṃmithunabhedataḥ ।। tāḥ paṃcadhā śuddhanamaḥ svāhā tṛptijayāṃtimāḥ ।। 11 ।।
śaktimālāpaṃcadhā syācchivamālāpi tādṛśī ।। dvaṃdvamālāpi tādṛk syādevaṃ paṃcadaśa kramāt ।। 12 ।।
śuddhānamoṃtāsvāhāṃtāstarpaṇāṃtā jayaṃtimāḥ ।। pravṛttayaḥ paṃcadhāsyurmālāsu nikhilāsvapi ।। 13 ।।
śuddhā saṃbuddhimātrā syājjapastena vidhīyate ।। manasā pūjanaṃ kāryaṃ pādukāṃ pūjayāmi ca ।। 14 ।।
svāheti home vacanaṃ tarpayāmi iti tarpaṇe ।। jayadvaṃdvasamāyogāt stutiruktā tu paṃcamī ।। 15 ।।
evaṃ paṃcavidhāyogo mālānāṃ tritaye bhavet ।। ataḥ paṃcadaśākhyātā mālānāmapallavau (4a) yeṣāṃ te traya ityevaṃ mālāmaṃtrāḥ paṃcadaśa bhavaṃti ityarthaḥ ।। 11 ।।
etadeva vivṛṇoti dvābhyāṃ pravṛttayaḥ mālāmaṃtrāṇāṃ prayogāḥ ।। 12 ।। 13 ।।
atha śuddhādilakṣaṇaṃ teṣāṃ viniyogamupapādayati ।। tribhi ।। atra pūjanahomatarpaṇaśabdāḥ tatphalapradajayapradāḥ śrīlalitāmanoḥ ।। 16 ।।
śuddhānāṃ ca jayāṃtānāṃ saṃbuddhiḥ sarvanāmasu ।। svāhāṃtānāṃ namoṃtānāṃ vibhaktiḥ sāṃpradāyikī ।। 17 ।।
dvitīyā tarpayāmaṃtā mālānāṃ viniyujyate ।। paṃcānāmapi mālānāṃ bhedoyaṃ varavarṇini ।। 18 ।।
maṃtraśaktimātreṇa puṣpājyatoyābhāvepi pūjāsiddheḥ vakṣyamāṇatvāt ।। namoṃtāsu pādukāṃ pūjayāmīti saptākṣaryapi cakārānnamaḥ samucitā yojanīyā sā ca pāṭhakramānnamonaṃtarameva ।। mālānāṃ tritaye pratyekaṃ pāṃcavidhyāt paṃcadaśetyarthaḥ ।। 14 ।। 15 ।। 16 ।।
saṃbuddhivibhaktiḥ saṃbodhanaṃ prathamaikavacanaṃ ।। sāṃpradāyikī caturthī vibhaktiḥ ।। 17 ।।
namaḥsvastisvāhetyādinā tathā eva tadyoge vidhānāt ।। tarpayateḥ karmasāpekṣatvā (4b) dvitīyāvibhaktireva sādhuḥ ।। śuddhānāmityādibahuvacanāni tattanmaṃtratrayaparāṇi ।। 18 ।।
kāmarājavidyāyāḥ kakārādihṛllekhāṃtaiḥ paṃcabhirvarṇaiḥ śaktimālāmaṃtrāḥ krameṇa paṃcajātāḥ hakārādilakārāṃtārṣaiḥ śaivāḥ māyādimāyāṃtairmithuna
śakteḥ śivasya dvaṃdvasya paṃcakatritayaṃ kramāt ।। aikaikasmātkādividyā kādivarṇātsamutthitaṃ ।। 19 ।।
ataḥ sarvāgameṣvetāḥ guhyāḥ paṃcadaśasrajaḥ ।। tritārītārahṛdayairekāśīti samāhvayaiḥ ।। 20 ।।
saṃbudhyaṃtairnamaste trivahnidāraiśca maṃḍitaḥ ।। śuddhāyā śaktidevatyā prakṛtiḥ senarasrajāṃ ।। 21 ।।
devatyaḥ ।। 19 ।।
ataḥ paṃcadaśākṣarotpannatvāddhetoḥ sarvataṃtreṣvapi tāḥ srajaḥ mālāmaṃtrāḥ tritārīvāṅamāyākamalāḥ tāraḥ praṇavaḥ hṛdayaṃ namaśabdaḥ ।। ekāśītyuttaraśatanāmāni ।। tripurasuṃdarītyādīni saṃmrājñaṃ tāni ।। 20 ।।
saṃbuddhiḥ saṃbodhanaṃ prathamaikavacanaṃ ।। tadaṃtāḥ namaste tririti svarūpāṃ ।। vahnidārāsvāhāśabdaḥ etairyuktāḥ (5a) śivadevatyaḥ dvaṃdvadevatyopi iti tayorvyāvartanāyāhaṃ ।। śaktīni ।। itarāsāṃ srajāṃ avaśiṣṭamālāmaṃtrāṇāṃ ।। 21 ।। itarāścaturdaśaitadvikṛtayaḥ iti paryavasannamarthamevāha ।। namoṃteti ।। yadyapi prātipadikamātrāṇāmeva tatpūrvamuddhārādvi-
namoṃtaḥ śaktimaṃtrādyā jayāṃtamithunāṃtimāḥ ।। asyā vikṛtayo jñeyā mālāmaṃtrāścaturdaśa ।। 22 ।।
saptāṣṭamālāmāhātmyaṃ paṃcabhirvadanairapi ।। na śakyate varārohe vaktuṃ varṣaśatairapi ।। 23 ।।
bhaktisāmānyarahitasya mālāmaṃtrasya paṃcadaśāpi vikṛtaya eva ।। tathāpi tādṛśasya maṃtratve mānābhāvādakṣaroddhārāvasare saṃbudhyaṃtā nāmevoddhārāstripurāsiddhibodhanamityādinā kaṃṭharaveṇāpi saṃbodhanāṃtasthaivoddhariṣyamāṇatvādyādṛśyā eva śaktimālādyā prakṛtitvaṃ satyāṣṭasrajamityekavacanamārṣaṃ ।। aṃ sādhyaiḥ vaidyaśāstracikitsārahitaiḥ yāpyaiḥ kaṣṭasādhyaiḥ sādhyaiḥ (5b) sulabhacikitsaiḥ gadaiḥ rogaiḥ ।। 23 ।। 24 ।। 25 ।। 26 ।।
pūjanaiḥ gṛhaviśeṣaiḥ ।। 27 ।।
puṣpādikapadatrayaṃ tatsādhanadravyamātropalakṣaṇaṃ ।। etairmaṃtraiḥ puṣpādibhiḥ pūjādi-
ekavāraṃ pratidinaṃ daśapaṃcasrajo japet ।। mahāpātakanirmuktaḥ sarvapuṇyamavāpnuyāt ।। 24 ।।
saptāṣṭamālāmāvartya saptāṣṭaṃ divasāvadhi ।। āptasādhyāmapi vadhūmākarṣaya vimohinīṃ ।। 25 ।।
māsamekaṃ samāvartya saptāṣṭasrajamuttamāṃ ।। asādhyayāpyasādhyākhyairmucyate trividhairgadaḥ ।। 26 ।।
saptāṣṭamālikājāpī nityaṃ puṇyamayākṛtiḥ ।। jvalannagnirivastatrairvikṣyate bhūtapūtanai ।। 27 ।।
pūjāhomastarpaṇaṃ vā maṃtraśaktiprabhāvataḥ ।। puṣpājyatoyābhāvepi japamātreṇa sidhyati ।। 28 ।।
kaṃ kartuṃ śakyasyāyaṃ pratinidhyupadeśamiti na bhramitavyaṃ ।। pūjādiṣveteṣāṃ viniyogā bhāvāt। na ca (6a) maṃtraliṃgaistatkalpanāliṃgasya sāmānyasaṃbaṃdhakāripramāṇāṃttarasāpekṣasyaiva viniyojakatvāt ।। 29 ।। ta{ta}śca namoṃtasvāhāṃtatarpaṇāṃtamaṃtratrayaṃ pūjāhomatarpaṇajanyaphaleṣvapi viniyujyate ।। puṣpābhāvepīti tattatsādhyapūjādyapekṣayā prakṛtajapasyādhikyadhvananapraśaṃsāmātraṃ ।। śuddhasya jayāṃtasya
saptāṣṭamālājapanaṃ pratyahaṃ kartumakṣamaḥ ।। prakṛtiṃ śuddhaśaktyākhyāṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ parikīrtayet ।। 29 ।।
sarvamālājapotthaṃ yatphalaṃ tatpuruṣośnute ।। ṛṣicchaṃdo devatā ca viniyogaṃ pṛthak pṛthak ।। 30 ।।
japastutyorviniyogaḥ ।। prāgukta eva ।। śuddhamālāyāstu nityapūjā pratinidhitvamāpadi vakṣyate ।। 28 ।।
paṃcadaśamālāsamaṣṭijapasyāyaṃ pratinidhirnatvaikaikasya ।। tatkāmyoktadinasaṃkhyā tu avaśyameva ।। 29 ।।
sarvamālājapotthaṃ samaṣṭijapajanyamākarṣaṇādi ।। ṛṣirmaṃtradraṣṭā ।। chaṃdaḥ maṃtrākṣarasaṃkhyāvachedakaṃ ।। devatāmaṃtrapratipādyā viniyogaḥ (aṃgāgībhāvaḥ ।। 30 ।।) - - - - - -
(6b) uttaratravakṣyamāṇāḥ paṃca{da}śa tayorviśeṣaṇānyapi pratyekaṃ vilakṣaṇāni {va}kṣyate ।। 31 ।।
yacchabdaḥ pādaparaḥ ।। padaṃghriścaraṇostriyāmityamaraḥ ।। dṛśa iti ṣaṣṭyaikavacanaṃ ।। prāṇyaṃgatvādekavadbhāvaḥ ।। paṃcakarmeṃdriyāṇi paṃcajñāneṃdriyāṇi ahaṃkārabuddhicittāni tatvāni ।। 32 ।।
pradhānapuruṣatatve ceti paṃcadaśādhiṣṭhātāro varuṇādi-
tattadādau samullikhya phalaślokaṃ ca kīrtayet ।। viśeṣaṇānyapi vadedṛṣidevatayo budhaḥ ।। 31 ।।
upasthapāyupatpāṇi vā ghrāṇarasanādṛśaḥ ।। tvak śrotrasyeṃdriyasyāhaṃ kṛterbuddheśca cetasaḥ ।। 32 ।।

siddhe brāhmi ca māheśvaryuktvā kaumāri kīrtayet ।। vaiṣṇavīti ca vārāhī tato māheṃdri kīrtayet ।। 15 ।।
tadārabhyāgastyamayyaṃtāḥ saptadivyaughāḥ ।। 8 ।। kālatāpanādyaścatvāraḥ siddhaughāḥ ।। viṣṇudevādyāḥ aṣṭau mānavaughāḥ। śrīkāro rāmānaṃde maṃtrāvayava eva ।। na ślokapūraṇamātrārtha iti vivekaḥ ।। evaṃ layāṃgadevatā uktāḥ ।। (14a) atha trailokyamohanacakranāmake trirekhātmake bhūbiṃbe daśasiddhayoṣṭau mātare daśamudrā ekācakranāthā ।। samaṣṭirūpayoginī ceti triṃśaddevatāpādonnaiḥ saptabhiślokaiḥ ।। 9 ।। 10 ।। 11 ।। 12 ।।
aṇimāsiddhipadasya bodhanaṃ saṃbuddhiḥ ।। siddha eva cetyatra saṃbudhyaṃta eva chedaḥ ।। evamuttaratrāpi āṇimādipadatrayamadaṃtaṃtvena ḍābaṃtaṃ ।। atīhrasvāṃtatāpattiḥ ।। sarvādityasya śabdaparatvena sarvasaṃjñābhāvānna smadādeśaḥ ।। 13 ।। 14 ।। 15 ।।
cāmuṃḍeti ।। iha saṃkṣobhaṇādiśabdebhyo lyuḍaṃtebhyo naṅīp ।। sarvān saṃkṣobhayatītyādyarthe puṇyasaṃśrayo yuṃjiti adhikāri paṭhitena yucā tadbodhena tato ṅīpo prasakteḥ ।। atastāchīlyeṇi nistato ṛbhebhyo ṅīp ।। tenokāropāṃtya svarāṇyetāni catvāri nāmāni ।। atha dvitīyāvaraṇadevatāḥ ṣoḍaśārasthāḥ ṣoḍaśa taccakranāthā yoginyau cetyaṣṭādaśapadānyuddharati sārdheḥścaturbhiḥ kiṃcidadhikaiḥ ।। 16 ।। 17 ।। 18 ।।
kāmādīnākarṣatīrthe ākarṣiṇī śabdāḥ
(14b) sarve lyuḍaṃtāḥ ।। na punarṇinyaṃtā iti bhramitavyaṃ ।। ahaṃkārātmāmṛtaśa
cāmuṃḍe ca mahālakṣmi sarvasaṃkṣobhaṇīti ca ।। sarvavidrāviṇi procya sarvākarṣiṇi śabdataḥ ।। 16 ।।
sarvādvaśaṃkarī procya sarvonmādini śabdataḥ ।। sarvānmahāṃkuśe sarva khecari procya sarvataḥ ।। 17 ।।
bīje sarvapadādyone kathayitvā tato vadet ।। sarvabhikhaṃḍe trailokyaśabdānmohanacakrataḥ ।। 18 ।।
svāminīti prakaṭato yoginīti padaṃ vadet ।। kāmārṣiṇi śabdāṃte budhyākarṣiṇi kīrtayet ।। 19 ।।
ahaṃkārākarṣiṇīti śabdākarṣaṇi kīrtayet ।। sparśākarṣaṇi śabdāṃte rūpākarṣaṇi kīrtayet ।। 20 ।।
rasākarṣaṇi śabdāṃte gaṃdhākarṣaṇi kīrtayet ।। cittākarṣaṇi śabdāṃte dhairyākarṣaṇi kīrtayet ।। 21 ।।
smṛtyākarṣaṇi śabdāṃte nāmākarṣaṇi kīrtayet ।। bījākarṣaṇi śabdāṃte ātmākarṣaṇi kīrtayet ।। 22 ।।
(15a) dveṣu puratoyaṇādeśepi kāryaḥ ।। vakṣyamāṇākṣarasaṃkhyānuguṇyāt ।। atha tṛtīyāvaraṇadevatāḥ aṣṭau cakranāthāyoginyau ceti daśanāmānyuddharati kiṃcidūnena pādonaślokatrayeṇa ।। 20 ।। 21 ।। 22 ।। 23 ।। 24 ।। 25 ।।
amṛtākarṣaṇītyuktvā śarīrākarṣaṇīti ca ।। sarvāśāparipūreti kacakrasvāminīti ca ।। 23 ।।
guptayoginyayānaṃgātkusumenaṃgamekhale ।। tataḥ paraṃ naṃgamadane naṃgamadanāture ।।24 ।।
taduttarenaṃgarekhenaṃgaveginya śabdataḥ ।। naṃgāṃkuśe naṃgaśabdān mālinyā bodhanaṃ vadet ।। 25 ।।
sarvasaṃkṣobhaṇāccakrasvāminīti ca guptataḥ ।। tarayoginiśabdācca sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇīti ca ।। 26 ।।
sarvavidrāviṇītyuktvā sarvākarṣiṇi śabdataḥ ।। sarvāhlādini śabdācca sarvasaṃmohinīti ca ।। 27 ।।
sarvastaṃbhīni śabdācca sarvajṛṃbhiṇi [śabdataḥ] kīrtayet ।। sarvadvaśaṃkaripadaṃ sarvaraṃjani śabdataḥ ।। 28 ।।
(15b) atrānaṃgetyakārāṇāṃ pūrvairekāraiḥ saha pūrvarūpaṃ ।। akāraparityāgena naṃgetyeva nirdeśāt ।। veginyaśabdata ityanena yaṇādeśaśca kathitaḥ ।।
atha caturthāvaraṇadevatāḥ ।। cakranāthā
sarvonmādini śabdācca padaṃ sarvārthasādhini ।। sarvasaṃpatti śabdāṃte puraṇīti padaṃ vadet ।। 29 ।।
sarvamaṃtramayītyuktvā sarvadvaṃdvakṣayaṃkarī ।। sarvasaubhāgyadāyīti kacakrasvāminīti ca ।। 30 ।।
saṃpradāyādyoginīti sarvasiddhiprade tataḥ ।। sarvasaṃpatprade procya paścāt sarvapriyaṃkarī ।। 31 ।।
yoginībhyāṃ saha ṣoḍaśopadiśatyāṃdyaṃtayorekaikapādādhikayā catuḥślokyā ।। 26 ।।
agre sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇyādayaḥ ।। sarvepi śabdāstā chīlyeṇi ṇyatāṃta ṅībaṃtāḥ ।। ato hrasvekāropāṃtyasvarāḥ daśaśabdāḥ ।। pūraṇīti tvakāropāṃtya eva bahusaṃmataḥ pāṭhaḥ ।। tena aṃtarbharitaṇyarthātpūryatereva lyuṭanapūrayateritīti draṣṭavyaṃ ।। atha paṃcamāvaraṇadevatācakrasvāmini yoginī ceti dvādaśanāmānyuddharati caturbhirādyaṃtapādadvayahīnaiḥ (16a) ślokaiḥ ।। 27 ।। 28 ।। 29 ।। 30 ।। sarvamaṃgalataḥ kāriṇyuktvā sarvācca kāmataḥ ।। prade sarva ityādiśabdāṃteti ।। atra kāriṇī dāyinī mocani vāriṇī padeṣu upāṃtasvarā ikārāḥ ।।
sarvamaṃgalataḥ kāriṇyuktvā sarvācca kāmataḥ ।। prade sarvapadādduḥkhavimocaniḥ padaṃ vadet ।। 32 ।।
sarvamṛtyupraśamani sarvavighnanivāriṇi ।। sarvāṃgasuṃdaripadaṃ sarvasaubhāgyadāyinī ।। 33 ।।
sarvārthasādhakāccakrasvāminīti padaṃ vadet ।। kūlottīrṇādyoginīti sarvajñe sarvaśabdataḥ ।। 34 ।।
śakte sarvaiśvaryapadāt prade iti samuccaret ।। sarvajñānamayi procya sarvāvyādhivināśini ।। 35 ।।
sarvādhārasvarūpe ca sarvapāpahare tathā ।। sarvānaṃdamayītyuktvā sarvarakṣāsvarūpiṇī ।। 36 ।।
anyeṣāmakāra eva śamanītyasya pūraṇīvadrūpaṃ ।। atha ṣaṣṭhāvaraṇe pūrva dvādaśa nāmānyāha ।। pādenāditaḥ sahitaistribhiḥ ślokaiḥ ।। 32 ।। 33 ।। 34 ।।
(16b) atra vināśinisvarūpiṇīti śabdāvikāropāṃtyasvarau ।। atha saptamāvaraṇaṃ devatānāṃ cakranāthā yoginībhyāṃ saha daśanāmāni samuddharati ।। sapādadvābhyāṃ ।। 35-39 ।।
sarvepsitaprade procya sarvarakṣākarātpunaḥ ।। cakrasvāmini śabdāṃte nigarbhādyoginīti ca ।। 37 ।।
vaśinīti padaṃ procya kāmeśvari ca modini ।। vimale cāruṇe paścājjayinīti padaṃ vadet ।। 38 ।।
sarveśvari padaṃ procya kaulinīti ca kīrtayet ।। sarvarogaharācakrasvāminīti rahasyataḥ ।। 39 ।।
athāyudhadevatāścatasraḥ ।। aṣṭamāvaraṇadevatāḥ api catasraḥ ।। cakranāthāyoginyau dve iti daśanāmāni nirdiśati ।। pādasahita dvābhyāṃ ।। 40 ।। 41 ।। 42 ।।
atha pratyāvaraṇamuktānāṃ tattaccakranāthānāṃ nāmāni krameṇoddharati dvābhyāṃ ।। atra tripurāṃ śrī ityatrareko dīrghaḥ ।। 43 ।। 44 ।।
siddhibodhanaṃ siddhe iti saṃbudhyaṃtaṃ ।।
(17a) ikārāṃtaḍābaṃtayoḥ saṃbuddhau vailakṣaṇyābhāvena prakṛtimaṃtroddhāranirvāhābhiprāyeṇa ।।
yoginīti samuccārya tato bāṇini cāpini ।। pāśinyaṃkuśini procya mahākāmeśvarīti ca ।। 40 ।।
mahāvajreśvaripadaṃ mahordhvaṃ bhagamālini ।। mahāśrīsuṃdarītyuktvā sarvasiddhipradāt punaḥ ।। 41 ।।
cakrasvāminyatipadādrahasyādatha yogini ।। śrīśrīpadānmahābhaṭṭārike padamudīrayet ।। 42 ।।
sarvānaṃdamayāccakrasvāminīti padaṃ vadet ।। parāpararahasyācca yoginī proccaret padaṃ ।। 43 ।।
tripure tripureśīti tathā tripurasuṃdari ।। tripurādvāsinipadaṃ tripurā śrīpadaṃ tataḥ ।। 44 ।।
tripurānmālini procya tripurātsiddhibodhanaṃ ।। tripurādaṃvaca procya mahātripurasuṃdarī ।। 45 ।।
mahāmāheśvarimahāmahārājñi mahāmahā ।। śakte mahāmahāgupte tataścaiva mahāmahā ।। 46 ।।
siddhe ityuktāvapi ābaṃtaśabda eva ।। tatrāṃtaravirodhāyāyaṃ svīkāryaḥ ।। namoṃtādiṣu (17b) phalabhedāt ।। 45 ।।
atha mahātripurasuṃdaryāḥ navaviśeṣaṇāni maṃtraśeṣanavākṣarīṃ coddharati ।। sārdhaistribhiḥ gupte iti ṭābaṃtasyā ।। saṃbuddhirnatvedaṃtasya ।। 46 ।।
jñatye mahāmahānaṃde tataḥ paścānmahāmahā ।। spaṃde mahāmahāśabdādāśaye parikīrtayet ।। 47 ।।
tato mahāmahāśabdaśrīcakranagarātpunaḥ ।। samrājñi padamuccārya namaste tripadaṃ vadet ।। 48 ।।
agnijāyāṃ vilomena tritārimapi kīrtayet ।। eṣā vidyā mahāsiddhidāyini smṛtimātṛtaḥ ।। 49 ।।
āśayapadaprathamākṣarasthamahāpade saṃdhita eva siddheḥ pṛthak uddhāraḥ ।। śayapadasya hastavācakasyaiva maṃtrāvayavatvaśramanirasāya ।। 47 ।।
samrājñītināṃtā deva ṅīpa ।। na tu kvivaṃtādrāṭ śabdāt ।। tena samomakārasya śravaṇaṃ chāṃdasaṃ ।। triḥpadaṃ tririti padaṃ ।। na punarnamaste ityasya trirāvṛttiriti bhramitavyaṃ ।। 48 ।।
agnijāyāṃ svāhā śabdaṃ tritārīṃ vilomena ramā māyā vāgbhaveti spaṣṭamanyat ।।
(18a) tena maṃtrārtha jñānapūrvakaṃ maṃtraṃ japediti dhvanitaṃ ।। uktaṃ ca parivasyā rahasye ।। nārtha jñānavihīnaṃ śabdasyoccāraṇaṃ phalitaṃ ।। bhasmani vahnivihīnena prākṣityaṃha virjvalati ।। 49 ।।
athaināṃ vidyāṃ anaikaiḥ phalaistauti ।। luṃṭhanaṃ svapratyakṣameva
agnivātabhayakṣobhe rājarāṣṭrasya viplave ।। luṃṭhaṇe taskarabhaye saṃgrāme salilaplave ।। 50 ।।
samudrayānavikṣepe bhūtapretādije bhaye ।। apasmārajarāvyādhimṛtyujanmādije bhaye ।। 51 ।।
ḍākinī pūtanā yakṣa rakṣaḥ kuṣmāṃḍaje bhaye ।। mitrabhede grahabhaye vyasane cābhikārike ।। 52 ।।
anyeṣvapi ca doṣeṣu mālāmaṃtraṃ smaraṃnnaraḥ ।। sarvopadravanirmuktaḥ sākṣāchivamayo bhavet ।। 53 ।।
sarvagrahaṇaṃ ।। parokṣe taddharaṇaṃ taskarakṛtyaṃ ।। 50 ।। ḍākinyādayo grahabhedāḥ ।। grahaṃ bhayaṃ ।। jalagrāhabhayaṃ ।। (18b) abhicārikavyasanaṃ ।। śatrukṛtamāraṇakarmajanyaṃ duḥkhaṃ ।। 52 ।। 53 ।।
āpatkārāgrahaniyaṃtraṇādirūpā ।। 54 ।।
āpatkāle nityapūjāṃ vistarāt kartumakṣamaḥ ।। ekāvartanamātreṇaṃ nityapūjāphalaṃ labhet ।। 54 ।।
mālāmaṃtro mahābhāgyalaṃbhyo jhaḍiti siddhikṛt ।। ekatriṃśatsahasrārṇastrilokimohanakṣamaḥ ।। 55 ।।
sarvasaṃkalpasaṃsiddhiretajñātvā naro bhavet ।। navāvaraṇadevīnāṃ lalitāyā mahojasā ।। 56 ।।
ekatriṃśadadhikaṃ sahasrarṇāḥ akṣarāṇi yasminniti madhyamapadalopagarbho vigrahaḥ ।। 55 ।।
sarveṣāṃ saṃkalpānāṃ manorathaviṣayībhūtānāṃ siddhiryasmātsaḥ ।। tripurasuṃdari iti prāthamikapadena mahānitye iti nityāyāṃ ṣoḍaśena padena mahāśrīsuṃdarītyāditi padena śrīśrīmahābhaṭṭāriketyādipadatrayeṇa mahātripurasuṃdarītyādi padadaśakena ca militvā ṣoḍaśabhiḥ padaiḥ lalitāyā eva kathanaṃmanyairnavāvaraṇadevatānāṃ kathanamiti vivekaḥ ।। 56 ।।
vedānāṃ karmakāṃḍasya vedāṃtānāṃ jñānakāṃḍasya gocaro viṣayaḥ ।।
(19a) sarvāgamānāṃ upāsanākāṃḍasya rahasyarūpo viṣayaḥ ।। 57 ।। 58 ।।
aṇimādayoṣṭau guṇā eva aiśvaryaṃ tena raṃjanaṃ nānārūpatāpādānaṃ ।। 59 ।।
itaḥ prakṛtirūpāt saṃbudhyaṃ śakti ekatragaṇanārūpā vedavedāṃtagocaraḥ ।। sarvāgamarahasyārthaḥ smaraṇāt pāpanāśanaṃ ।। 57 ।।
lalitāyā maheśānyā mālāvidyāmāhīyasī ।। naravaśyaṃ nareṃdrāṇāṃ vaśyaṃ nārīvaśīkaraḥ ।। 58 ।।
aṇimādiguṇaiśvaryaṃ raṃjanaṃ pāpabhaṃjanaṃ ।। tattadāvaraṇasyāpi devatāvṛṃdamaṃtrajaṃ ।। 59 ।।
mālāmaṃtramayaṃ guhyaṃ paraṃdhāmaprakīrtitaṃ ।। caturdaśānāmanyāsāṃ mālānāmita udbhavaḥ ।। 60 ।।
dvitīyāṃtāścaturthyaṃtāḥ saṃbudhyaṃtāstriṣaḍasāḥ ।। paṃcapaṃcapunaḥ paṃcastrīpuṃsamithunātmikāḥ ।। 61 ।।
triguṇaḥ kalpatarayo nityā devīsamaṣṭayaḥ ।। nityā krameṇa saṃjaptā mahānityātmadā pradāḥ ।। 62 ।।
maṃtrān ।। 60 ।।
paṃcadaśasu mālāsu pratipaṃcakamekaike ca tisro dvitīyāṃtāḥ ।।
(19b) dve dve caturthyaṃta iti ṣaṭ ।। dve dve saṃbudhyaṃte ityapi rasāḥ ṣaḍeveti paṃcakatrayaṃ pratyekaṃ kalpitārthapradātvāt kalpadrumarūpaṃ ।। svarge tu paṃcaiva maṃdārapārijātāḥ kalpavṛkṣāḥ ।। eteṣu triguṇāḥ paṃcadaśakāmeśvarādicitrāṃtanityo paṃcadaśakasamaṣṭirūpā ete maṃtrāḥ pratipadādipūrṇimāṃtatattatithiṣu krameṇa japtāśceti tripurasuṃdarimahānityāsvarūpalābhameva kurvatu ityarthaḥ ।। 61 ।। 62 ।।
atha caturdaśavikṛtīnāṃ pratyekamakṣarasaṃkhyājñānāyānugamakaṃ sugamamupāyamāha ।। sārdhena nāmabhissāmrājñītyaṃtairekāśītyadhika- śatasaṃkhyākaiḥ prātipadikaiḥ tatsaṃkhyayeti yāvat ।। pallavārṇāni namaḥ pādukāṃ pujayāmi ।। svāhā ।। tarpayāmi ।। jayajayeti pallavāni ।। teṣāmakṣarāṇi ।। nava dve catvāri ceti saṃkhyākāni guṇayet ।। tatra guṇitasaṃkhyāpiṃḍe ।। nāmākṣarāṇi ṣoḍaśottarasahasrasaṃkhyākākṣarasaṃkhyānityāśca ।। paṃcadaśasaṃkhyā ca yojayet ।। prakṛtimaṃtrādināmāni (20a) ṣaḍakṣarāṇi tadaṃtimāni navākṣarāṇi ceti militvoktapiṃḍe melayedityarthaḥ ।। yadyapi prakṛtimaṃtrākṣarāṇi yojayedityekoktau vede sidhyati ।। tathāpi mithunamaṃtreṣu nāmākṣarāṇāṃ dvirniveśaḥ ।। paṃcadaśākṣarāṇāṃ tu sakṛdeveti viśeṣadhvananāya pārthakyena nirdeśaḥ ।। vibhakteḥ caturthyā dvitīya yāvā ।। tataḥ strīliṃganāmasu nityaklinnādi katipaya ṭāvaṃtādipadeṣu prakṛtitokṣarādhikyaṃ yathā nityaklinnāyai ityādi ।। tāni cāṣṭatriṃśadeva ।। pulliṃga
tāsu tu prakṛtiḥ saikatriṃśaddvarṇaṃ sahasrayuk ।। nāmabhiḥ pallavārṇāni guṇayettatra yojayet ।। 63 ।।
nāmākṣarāṇi nityāśca vibhakterakṣarāṇi ca ।। saṃdhīnviyojya vikṛtervarṇasaṃkhyā vinirdiśet ।। 64 ।।
mālāsu tu tripurasuṃdarāyetyādirītyā ṣaḍviṃśatyuttaraśatanāma svarādhikyaṃ ।। (126) ।।
